question: Does the Warp Agent CLI (`warp` binary) have a prompt-and-exit (print) mode? Its reference lists only --api-key, --auto-approve, --resume, --set-provider-api-key, --clear-provider-api-key, --help and --version; the documented one-shot command is the legacy `oz agent run --prompt`.
why: the unit asked for the Warp Agent CLI's headless mode; the pages read document headless authentication (WARP_API_KEY) but no prompt flag for `warp`, and the oz CLI is called a supported legacy interface. A run of `warp --help` needs an installed binary, which only an account holder or the operator can run.
